newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Feb oil output down 11.9-pct yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Feb oil output down 11.9-pct yr-on-yr.

text.p: Singapore's February petroleum products manufacturing output fell by 11.9 percent compared with the same month a year before, the Economic Development Board (EDB) said on Thursday.
"Output of petroleum products fell by 11.9 percent as refiners were hit by poor margins caused by slackened demand after winter," EDB said in a statement.
"Cumulative output for the first two months was reduced by 7.2 percent compared to the same period in 1996."
Industry sources said the lower production was also due to cuts in runs of between seven and 20 percent by two refiners since the week ending January 17.
One refiner, Shell Singapore, brought runs back to normal on the week ending February 22.
But the other refiner, Esso Singapore, which cut refining runs by 15-20 percent declined to confirm if they had raised output back to normal as of late February.
